offering_description.value: Mines, processes and sells salt and specialty plant nutrition fertilizers. It sells deicing salt to municipalities and highway agencies, food and water-treatment salt to industrial users, and fertilizer to agricultural customers, mostly from mines and evaporation operations in North America and the UK.

primary_products.value: deicing salt; food and water-treatment salt; industrial salt; consumer salt; sulfate of potash fertilizer

customer_segment.value: B2B: food processors, agricultural retailers, water treatment operators, industrial users; B2G: municipalities, state and provincial highway agencies; B2C: consumers buying water-softener and packaged salt through retail stores

end_markets.value: road maintenance; agriculture; food and beverage; water treatment; industrial manufacturing; consumer

revenue_model.value: product sales: salt and fertilizer sold in bulk and packaged form to customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes mined and evaporated brine into salt and fertilizer, sold to distributors and end users; asset operator: runs salt mines, evaporation ponds and processing plants, takes in brine and ore, sells finished products

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, UK and Brazil, plus exports to other countries

specialization.value: related lines: salt products and plant nutrition fertilizers, sharing mining, evaporation and logistics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large industrial, agricultural and municipal customers; distributors / dealers: agricultural and salt distributors that resell to local customers; own locations: company mines, plants, warehouses and terminals where product is shipped from; third-party retail: retail chains selling packaged salt to consumers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining, environmental and worker safety rules from US, Canadian and UK regulators governing mining and emissions

notes: Product mix and geographic footprint may have changed; details are based on general knowledge of the company.
